## validateRequirementSpender() function

Validates that a requirement encoder spender matches one of the allowed chain addresses.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateRequirementSpender: (params: {
    readonly chainId: number;
    readonly spender: Address;
    readonly allowed: readonly RequirementSpenderKey[];
}) => void
```

**Returns:**

void

Nothing after the spender matches an allowed chain address.

## Exceptions

`UnsupportedErc20ApprovalSpenderError` when `spender` does not match any allowed slot.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id used to resolve supported spender addresses.

- `params.spender`<!-- -->: Spender address to validate.

- `params.allowed`<!-- -->: Allowed registry slots for this requirement.

## Example


```ts
import { validateRequirementSpender } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";
import { getChainAddress } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

validateRequirementSpender({
  chainId: 8453,
  spender: getChainAddress(8453, "midnightBundles"),
  allowed: ["midnightBundles"],
});
```
